items.title: "The Social Democrats are failing women in healthcare"
items.summary: The Social Democrats call themselves the party of equality - but in Region Stockholm the policy has had the opposite effect. Women are affected as patients, staff and relatives when care is lacking, write L debaters.
items.summary_original: Socialdemokraterna kallar sig jämställdhetens parti – men i Region Stockholm har politiken fått motsatt effekt. Kvinnor drabbas som patienter, personal och anhöriga när vården brister, skriver L-debattörer.

items.title: SMHI warns: Now the storm Dave is moving in
items.summary: SMHI has issued an orange warning for storm winds of 25-30 meters per second in western and central Sweden when storm Dave moves in on Sunday. From the middle of the day until the evening it will be windy at its worst. The authorities urge everyone not to go out on the roads, unless you have to.
items.title_original: SMHI varnar: Nu drar stormen Dave in
items.summary_original: SMHI har utfärdat en orange varning för stormvindar på 25-30 meter per sekund i västra och mellersta Sverige när stormen Dave drar in på söndagen. Från mitt på dagen och fram till kvällen kommer det att blåsa som värst. Myndigheterna uppmanar alla att inte ge sig ut på vägarna, om man inte måste.

items.title: Mercedes CLA: The brand's most important electric car for a long time
items.summary: The Mercedes CLA is the brand's most important car for a long time. It shows that Mercedes is a player to be reckoned with in the context of electric cars with its low consumption, long range and fast charging. At the same time, they have lost in parts where Mercedes usually shines and make it unnecessarily complicated for the customer.
items.title_original: Mercedes CLA: Märkets viktigaste elbil på länge
items.summary_original: Mercedes CLA är märkets viktigaste bil på länge. Den visar att Mercedes är en spelare att räkna med i elbilsammanhang med sin låga förbrukning, långa räckvidd och snabba laddning. Samtidigt har man tappat i delar där Mercedes vanligtvis glänser och gör det onödigt komplicerat för kunden.

items.title: Maria Malmer Stenergard visits Spain
items.summary: Minister for Foreign Affairs Maria Malmer Stenergard visited Spain on 26 March. She visited the Swedish Honorary Consulate in Torrevieja and met with expatriate Swedes, civil society organisations and political representatives. Ms Malmer Stenergard also attended the Sweden-Ukraine men’s football World Cup qualifier match.

items.title: Minister for Rural Affairs Peter Kullgren welcomes Germany to For Forest+
items.summary: Sweden is this year’s chair of the For Forest+ group. In this context, Minister for Rural Affairs Peter Kullgren hosted a meeting of the group’s members on 31 March, during which the group welcomed Germany as a new member. With the addition of Germany, For Forest+ now consists of eight EU Member States that collectively account for around 60 per cent of the forests of the 27 EU Member States (EU27).

items.title: SEK 240 million in new support to Ukraine
items.summary: The Government has presented a new support package to Ukraine for 2026 worth around SEK 240 million. The support includes SEK 150 million for the Ukrainian Red Cross for humanitarian operations. In addition, the support package is heavily focused on children’s needs, supporting the provision of school food in areas close to the frontline, promoting reforms for family-based care of children and supporting children’s mental health.

items.title: SEK 555 million in new humanitarian aid for Gaza
items.summary: After more than two years of war and suffering, children in Gaza are in acute need of health and medical care, psychosocial support, safety, nutrition and education. Initiatives in these areas are needed to lay the foundations for reconstruction and recovery. Sweden is now providing SEK 555 million in aid, which will be distributed between the UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF), the UN World Food Programme (WFP) and the United Nations Development Programme, and will help bring safety, stability and well-being to children in Gaza.
